text_block_list.text: No, no, no, no! This can't be happening!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest racer can't settle
for
anything less than victory! I refuse to
accept this!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Trainer! Be honest! How did I do?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: You ran pretty well out there.

text_block_list.text: Trainer! Be honest! How did I do?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: You ran pretty well out there.

text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back! Sugarcoating it isn't
gonna help
me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
"Pretty well" doesn't cut it! I don't want
to deliver
anything but perfection!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Then let's aim for a perfect score in training!

text_block_list.text:
Claro! I'll give you an unbelievable,

unsurmountable—perfect performance!
Give me
all you've got in training!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oof! That low?! And oddly specific, as
well.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
This is so embarrassing... More
embarrassing than
when I got that awful
test score!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But! The higher the wall, the sweeter the
breeze
at the top when you scale it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Sí! Next time, I'll be laughin' from up
top!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'll climb the steepest cliffs in Mexico if
that's
what it takes!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Then, I'm gonna swoop down
magnificently from
the summit of the
world!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
